item.title: Grinding Gear Games still hopes to finish Path of Exile 2 in 2026, but it will be later than planned
item.description: Path of Exile 2 has been in early access for around a year at this stage, but we are still quite a long ways off from release. The next major update will bring the game up to Version 0.4, although Grinding Gear Games says it is going to do everything it can to ensure that Version 1.0 does not slip into 2027.
